Modern scenario

Blend Chinese wedding tradition with a modern reception.

Use this scenario when the couple wants visible tradition without making the reception feel crowded or confusing.

Best forModern reception
Main decisionTiming balance
Products laterDecor, signs, checklist
Open checklistAll resources

Choose visible anchors

A modern wedding does not need every custom. Choose a few visible anchors: tea ceremony, red envelopes, family blessings, or tasteful red-gold details.

Protect the schedule

Plan the custom moments so they support the day instead of interrupting it. Clear timing makes tradition feel intentional.
